mapper.select: SELECT 100 - IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(PRIN_AMT, 0)), 0) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND MDATE <= #{settleDate,jdbcType=DATE}
select PROFIT_TYPE from fin_product where FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and LIMIT = 1

select a.basis from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE a inner join FIN_CASH_INFO b on a.cash_id=b.cash_id where a.eff_date=STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and b.branch=#{branch} and b.finprod_id=#{finprodId} group by a.basis

select round(a.yield,2) as yield from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE a where STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d')>=a.eff_date and a.branch=#{branch} and a.finprod_id=#{finprodId} and LIMIT=1 order by a.eff_date desc

select t.exercise_date exerciseDate, t.exercise_type exerciseType from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN t where t.exercise_date>STR_TO_DATE(#{exerciseDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and t.finprod_id=#{finprodId} and t.finprod_type=#{finprodtype} order by t.exercise_date asc

select sum(t.pos_value+t.tdy_intincexp) fairePrice from ASSET_TARGET_DB t where t.cdate=STR_TO_DATE(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d') and t.pinan_asset_type=#{finprodType}
and t.IS_PERNE= #{pass}
